description: Manage ConnectWise Control (ScreenConnect) sessions, users and the audit log from one CLI.

novel_features.name: Stale guest sessions
novel_features.description: List sessions whose guest has not connected for at least --days (default 30), oldest first, plus sessions with no recorded connection.

novel_features.name: User access review
novel_features.description: Flag instance users that are disabled, have an expired password, or belong to no security group, with each user's groups listed.
